title: Top Trader Profile: Nicolas Darvas
description: Nicolas Darvas was a legendary trader who believed price and volume were the most important market activity indicators.
body_html:
Nicolas Darvas was a legendary trader who believed price and volume were the most important market activity indicators. He once said, "The only sound reason for my buying a stock is that it is rising in price. If that is happening, no other reason is required. If that is not happening, no other reason is worth considering." This quote highlights his focus on price and the importance of strong price trends.

To identify these trends, Darvas was a firm believer in the use of charts. He used a combination of charts, volume, and patterns to identify potential buying and selling opportunities. He once stated, "I consider charts to be the footprints of big money and the tape reading as the thermometer of the market."

However, Darvas believed it was essential to trade with the trend rather than against it. He looked for stocks that were making higher highs and higher lows, indicating an uptrend, or lower lows and lower highs, indicating a downtrend. He once said, "I soon found out that I had been buying on the way down when I should have been buying on the way up. I had placed my stops too close to the market when they should have been distant."

To limit potential losses, Darvas was a strong advocate of using stop-loss orders. He placed his stop-loss orders just below the stock's support level so that he would automatically exit the trade if the stock price fell below this level. He once stated, "I prefer to cut my losses and get out of a stock when my reasons for owning it are no longer valid. Why stay in it?"

Darvas had a specific focus on high-growth stocks. He believed these stocks were likelier to show strong price trends and deliver long-term gains. He looked for stocks with strong earnings growth and a high potential for future growth. He once said, "I'm not a businessman; I'm a momentum investor... I look for stocks with good earnings potential, and if the stock is moving up, I'll buy it."

Finally, Darvas patiently waited for the right opportunities to present themselves. He was willing to wait for the right stock to show strong price and volume trends before entering a trade, and he was willing to hold onto winning trades for as long as the trend continued. He once stated, "When I have made a killing in the market, I have always sold too soon."

Nicolas Darvas was a trader who focused on price and volume, used charts to identify trends and patterns, traded with the trend, used stop-loss orders to limit potential losses, focused on high-growth stocks, and had the patience to wait for the right opportunities to present themselves. His principles continue to inspire traders to this day.

Key concepts:

  • Focus on price and volume

  • Use of charts

  • Trading with the trend

  • Use of stop-loss orders

  • Cut losses quickly

  • Focus on high-growth stocks

  • Patience

Books:

  • "How I Made $2,000,000 in the Stock Market" by Nicolas Darvas

  • "Wall Street: The Other Las Vegas" by Nicolas Darvas

  • "You Can Still Make It In The Market"
